chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from one of his companions, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
The servant does not cease to be within the limits of the circumambulation (Tawaf) by the Ka'bah for as long as the shaving of the head is upon him.

key_terms.حَلْقُ الرَّأْسِ: Shaving of the head (a key pillar of Hajj)

ai.seo_question: When does the ritual of Tawaf officially end according to Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: In Shia jurisprudence, this hadith from al-Kafi clarifies that Tawaf al-Ifadah is not a single instantaneous act but a continuous process extending until the completion of Halaq (shaving) or Qasr (trimming). This ruling underscores the holistic nature of the Hajj rites, linking the physical act of circumambulation with the subsequent act of exiting the state of Ihram, thereby ensuring the ritual's validity is maintained throughout this transitional phase.
